title: Make and remove
goal: Create a case folder, add an empty note, and remove the files you no longer need.

cheatSheet.description: Create a directory and any missing parents.
Create an empty file, or update the time on one that exists.
Remove a file. rm on its own will not remove a directory.
Remove a directory and everything inside it.
Remove an empty directory. It refuses one that still has files.

files.content: Scratch file. Remove this once your folder exists.
Superseded draft. Remove the whole old directory.
Incoming notes land here. Leave this folder as it is.

tasks.prompt: Create the directory cases/incidents/2026-03-auth, including any missing parents.
tasks.hint: mkdir stops if a parent is missing. -p creates the chain.

tasks.prompt: Add an empty notes.txt inside that new directory.
tasks.hint: touch creates an empty file. Use the full path from home, or cd in first.
rm takes the file path. It does not ask for confirmation in this lab.

tasks.prompt: Remove the cases/old directory and the file inside it.
tasks.hint: A plain rm refuses a directory. -r removes the directory and its contents.

tasks.prompt: Create an empty directory called cases/empty-dir.
tasks.hint: mkdir is enough. You do not need -p if cases already exists.
rmdir only works when the directory has nothing in it.
